Phase 4 · Approval gate

Present and Defend the Recommendation

Connect the whole semester in one integrated oral presentation.

Decision question

Can every member explain how the evidence leads to the client recommendations?

Present the economic review, client mandates, security research and portfolio analysis as one evidence-linked recommendation for all three clients.

Committee motion

Confirm that the final presentation matches the portfolio workbook and that every member is ready to explain the evidence.

Do this in order

Your Phase 4 sequence

  1. 1

    Use the completed economic review, IPS statements, security research and Phase 3 workbook as your evidence.

  2. 2

    Build a visual PowerPoint presentation connecting the market outlook to each client recommendation.

  3. 3

    Show key portfolio comparisons, stress results, trade-offs and monitoring triggers.

  4. 4

    Rehearse balanced speaking responsibilities and questions across all five roles.

  5. 5

    Submit the presentation in Canvas and deliver the integrated oral presentation and Q&A.

Before the gate

Definition of done

  • Slides match the final Phase 3 workbook and identify sources and assumptions.
  • Each of the three client recommendations follows from the economic outlook, IPS, research and risk analysis.
  • Every member can explain their contribution and defend the integrated recommendation.
  • The team has checked the Canvas upload and is ready for the oral presentation.

Workstreams

Integrated story

Connect the economic review and IPS statements to research, portfolio weights and risk decisions.

Visual evidence

Use clear exhibits from the completed Phase 3 workbook and cite the supporting research.

Oral presentation and Q&A

Share speaking responsibilities and prepare every member to explain the integrated recommendation.

Required evidence

  • Slides match the final Phase 3 workbook and identify sources and assumptions.
  • Each of the three client recommendations follows from the economic outlook, IPS, research and risk analysis.
  • Every member can explain their contribution and defend the integrated recommendation.
  • The team has checked the Canvas upload and is ready for the oral presentation.

Committee responsibilities

Committee seatResponsibility in Phase 4
Client and Macro StrategistDefend client suitability, the macro assumptions, and the line from scenario-based need to recommendation.
Fixed-Income AnalystDefend the portfolio's income, capital-preservation, interest-rate, and credit-risk trade-offs.
Equity AnalystDefend equity exposures, vehicle choices, limited individual-security decisions, rejected alternatives, and their client fit.
Portfolio ManagerState and defend the integrated recommendation, portfolio construction decisions, final weights, rejected integrations, and implementation priorities.
Risk and Derivatives AnalystDefend the stress evidence, residual risk, hedge or no-hedge decision, limits of the analysis, and conditions that would change the risk response.

Approval standard

Gate 4

Deliver the integrated presentation and answer questions about client suitability, portfolio trade-offs and risk.

Use the completed Phase 3 workbook as the portfolio record. The Phase 4 deliverable is the integrated presentation and Q&A.
